independent_unit: held-out recording session (five sessions documented from three animals)
animal_grouping_note: The 105/106/107 session-code prefixes are reported as descriptive three-animal groups; the five held-out sessions remain the unit used for predictive comparisons.
parameterization: one shape parameter shared across four training sessions plus one neuron-specific rate/scale parameter profiled by native-count likelihood on the held-out neuron's calibration trials
nuisance_calibration_note: At fixed shared shape, each family receives exactly one neuron-level nuisance parameter. That parameter is profiled against the native-count calibration likelihood for every family; scoring is performed only on the disjoint half.

parameter_domain.power_cost: alpha>0, beta>0; unbounded log-beta; positive-cost active branch only
parameter_domain.shape_search: positive shapes; initial windows expand if an endpoint is competitive; unresolved boundary fits raise rather than being accepted

qc_note: Strict QC is determined using all trials before calibration/test splitting; predictions are conditional on retrospectively QC-selected neurons
training_objective: mean per-neuron per-trial native-count NLL; nuisance is reprofiled at every shared-shape objective; objective evaluations cached within each fit

spontaneous.scope: conditional fixed-shape separability; the generating family is scored with its generating shape, not a recovery of LOSO shape learning

driven.scope: conditional fixed-shape separability; the generating family is scored with its generating shape, not a recovery of LOSO shape learning
